lead.headline: Paradigm's $1.2B Fund IV Marks the End of Crypto-Only Venture Capital
lead.tldr: The week's signals trace a single arc: crypto-native firms are repricing themselves as frontier technology investors, while governments on both sides of the Atlantic race to build the regulatory rails that will determine where tokenized value actually settles.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, this week the infrastructure of tokenized finance advanced faster than the capital deploying into it, and the gap between those two clocks is where we are underwriting.

top_signals.title: Announcing Our Fourth Fund
top_signals.summary: Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Paradigm's $1.2 billion Fund IV, with its explicit expansion into AI and robotics, signals that the top-tier crypto VC brand is now pricing crypto as one frontier among several rather than the frontier, which reprices every crypto-native founder's competitive set for capital.

top_signals.title: US, UK treasuries to align transatlantic rules on tokenization and stablecoins38m, US, UK treasuries to align transatlantic rules on tokenization and stablecoinsThe two governments issued recommendations on the treatment of digital assets as the US prepares to implement a 2025 law on payment stablecoins.
top_signals.summary: The US and UK treasuries are working to align regulatory frameworks for tokenization and stablecoins. This coordination comes as the US prepares to implement new laws regarding payment stablecoins in 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: US-UK treasury alignment on stablecoin rules creates a transatlantic regulatory corridor that will concentrate compliant issuance infrastructure in jurisdictions with interoperable standards, penalizing fragmented or offshore alternatives.

top_signals.title: Decentralized AI project Nous Research in talks to raise $75M at $1.5B valuation: report
top_signals.summary: Decentralized AI project Nous Research is reportedly in talks to raise at least $75 million. The funding round is led by Robot Ventures and values the company at $1.5 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Nous Research's $1.5 billion valuation at the intersection of decentralized infrastructure and AI model training tests whether crypto networks can capture value from compute demand rather than merely facilitating it.

top_signals.title: UK lays out tokenized finance roadmap with projected £33 billion annual boost
top_signals.summary: The UK government has unveiled a strategic roadmap for tokenized finance, aiming to modernize financial infrastructure. The initiative is projected to provide a £33 billion annual boost to the economy by enabling real-time settlement and asset efficiency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The UK's £33 billion annual GDP projection for tokenized finance provides a government-validated demand floor that reduces regulatory risk for infrastructure builders targeting institutional issuance pipelines.

top_signals.title: President Trump, White House press Senate to advance the Clarity Act while ethics fight looms
top_signals.summary: President Trump and the White House are pressuring the Senate to advance the Clarity Act. This move represents a concerted effort by the administration to establish a formal legal framework for cryptocurrency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: White House pressure to advance the Clarity Act accelerates the timeline for a federal crypto framework, compressing the window for regulatory arbitrage strategies and repricing securities law uncertainty as a near-term solvable problem.

top_signals.title: Japan’s largest security token platform moves nearly $3 billion to Avalanche blockchain
top_signals.summary: Progmat, the dominant security token platform in Japan, is migrating nearly $3 billion in assets to the Avalanche blockchain. This move represents a significant expansion of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization on a public blockchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Progmat's $3 billion migration to Avalanche demonstrates that Japanese institutional RWA tokenization has selected public blockchain infrastructure over permissioned alternatives, validating Avalanche's subnet architecture for regulated asset settlement.

deals.summary: Paradigm has announced the launch of its fourth fund, raising $1.2 billion. The capital is intended to support ambitious builders working at the frontier of technology and Web3.
Decentralized AI project Nous Research is reportedly in talks to raise at least $75 million. The funding round is led by Robot Ventures and values the company at $1.5 billion.
Gauntlet, founded by Tarun Chitra, has raised $125 million in a Series C funding round. The investment was provided solely by SBI Holdings to support the growth of DeFi, tokenization, and vaults.

Velocity has raised $38 million to develop stablecoin treasury infrastructure specifically designed for enterprise use. The funding aims to bridge the gap between traditional corporate finance and digital asset management.

Stablecoin startup Velocity has raised $38 million in a Series A funding round led by Dragonfly and FirstMark. The platform focuses on bridging corporate stablecoin usage with traditional banking rails and compliance systems.

MicroStrategy has raised approximately $467 million through the sale of MSTR shares. This move has increased the company's US dollar reserves to $3 billion while maintaining its current Bitcoin holdings.

on_the_radar.title: Housing bill that includes a CBDC ban passed into law without Trump's signature
on_the_radar.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act has officially become law, incorporating a critical provision that prohibits the Federal Reserve from issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). The bill passed into law without requiring a signature from President Trump.

on_the_radar.title: USDC issuer Circle wins final approval for US national trust bank charter20m
on_the_radar.summary: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, has received final approval for a US national trust bank charter. This regulatory milestone allows the company to operate as a federally chartered bank, enhancing its legitimacy and operational capabilities within the US financial system.

on_the_radar.title: Swift launches blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit pilot with 17 banks
on_the_radar.summary: Swift has launched a blockchain-based ledger to facilitate a pilot program for 24/7 cross-border payments. The initiative involves 17 banks utilizing tokenized deposits to streamline international transfers.

on_the_radar.title: SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilot31m, SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilotSWIFT launched its new blockchain ledger that will host a tokenized bank deposit pilot for 17 major banks seeking faster cross-border payments.
on_the_radar.summary: SWIFT has launched a new blockchain ledger to facilitate a tokenized deposit pilot involving 17 major banks. The initiative aims to significantly increase the speed and efficiency of cross-border payments.

on_the_radar.title: US Treasury, Tether Freezes $131M in Crypto Tied to Iran
on_the_radar.summary: The US Treasury has ordered Tether to freeze over $131 million in USDT associated with wallets linked to Iran's central bank. This action comes amid escalating hostilities in the Middle East.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum Foundation privacy team spins out as for-profit EthSystems to serve institutions with Lubin, Bitmine backing
on_the_radar.summary: The Ethereum Foundation's privacy team is spinning out into a for-profit entity called EthSystems. The new company aims to provide privacy-focused infrastructure for institutional users with backing from Lubin and Bitmine.

on_the_radar.title: US-UK transatlantic taskforce unveils digital asset roadmap promoting stablecoin innovation
on_the_radar.summary: The United States and United Kingdom have established a transatlantic taskforce to coordinate on digital asset roadmaps. The initiative specifically focuses on promoting innovation for stablecoins and tokenized assets.

on_the_radar.title: UK government defers capital gains on certain crypto with ‘no gain, no loss’ approach28m, UK government defers capital gains on certain crypto with ‘no gain, no loss’ approachThe change in tax policy, expected to impact about 700,000 people in the UK, was related to the disposal of crypto in lending and liquidity pools.
on_the_radar.summary: The UK government is implementing a 'no gain, no loss' approach to defer capital gains tax on certain cryptocurrency transactions. This policy specifically targets the disposal of crypto assets within lending and liquidity pools, potentially benefiting around 700,000 individuals.

on_the_radar.title: JCB Signs Circle MOU to Explore USDC Payments in Japan
on_the_radar.summary: Japanese payment giant JCB has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Circle to explore the use of USDC for merchant payments and cross-border treasury transfers. This partnership aims to integrate stablecoin technology into Japan's existing payment infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: CleanSpark Signs $6.6B Data Center Lease in Georgia
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin miner CleanSpark has entered into a 20-year data center lease agreement in Georgia valued at $6.6 billion. The deal is with an undisclosed technology company and has led to a rise in CleanSpark's share price.

on_the_radar.title: European Central Bank taps 36 payment providers for yearlong digital euro pilot
on_the_radar.summary: The European Central Bank has selected 36 payment providers to participate in a yearlong pilot for the digital euro. The beta testing phase is scheduled to begin in late 2027.

on_the_radar.title: Humanity Protocol to Prioritize Operational Security following $36M Hack
on_the_radar.summary: Humanity Protocol is shifting its security focus toward operational security following a $36M hack. The protocol aims to combat the trend of attackers targeting human behavior rather than smart contract vulnerabilities.

worth_a_read.title: JTX: Solana’s New Trading Layer
worth_a_read.note: Solana's execution layer fragmentation is accelerating; this piece maps how JTX competes for order flow and what it means for MEV capture on the chain.

worth_a_read.title: TradFi doesn’t want DeFi. It wants blockchain.
worth_a_read.note: The a16z argument that TradFi seeks blockchain rails without DeFi composability reframes the tokenization TAM and explains why institutional pilots often stall at the smart contract layer.

worth_a_read.title: Exclusive: Defence tech Project Q lands €15m Series A 11 months after last raise
worth_a_read.note: Defence tech's rapid capital formation in Europe offers a parallel read on how regulated, mission-critical infrastructure attracts sovereign capital pools that crypto infrastructure builders may eventually compete for.

worth_a_read.title: Macro & Markets Mid Year Report Card
worth_a_read.note: Delphi's mid-year macro assessment provides the risk framework within which crypto assets are currently being repriced against rates, liquidity, and correlation regimes.

worth_a_read.title: Arcium: Enabling The Next Phase Of Private On-Chain Activity
worth_a_read.note: Arcium's approach to programmable privacy addresses the compliance bottleneck that has prevented institutional DeFi deployment at scale.

linkedin_post:
Paradigm raised $1.2 billion and immediately told the market it is no longer a crypto fund. AI and robotics now share the mandate. We have seen this movie before in venture: the brand outruns the category that built it.

The harder signal is what this does to pricing in the crypto-native stack. When the top decile of crypto venture capital rebrands as frontier technology, every pure-play crypto founder competes against a broader pool for the same checks. The premium on 'crypto-only' conviction compresses. The carry on being a generalist expands.

This same week, the UK projected £33 billion in annual GDP from tokenized finance, and Progmat moved $3 billion of Japanese security tokens to Avalanche. Governments and institutions are building the rails. Paradigm is diversifying off them. The dissonance is the point.

We underwrite the infrastructure layer on whether tokenized assets settle on public chains with regulatory clarity, not on whether crypto VCs stay crypto. The test for our thesis is whether Progmat's Avalanche migration gets replicated by European or Middle Eastern issuers before year-end. If it stalls, the RWA narrative reprices. If it compounds, the value shifts to compliant node operators and issuance infrastructure, not to the funds that once monopolized the storytelling.

Velocity's $38 million Series A for stablecoin treasury infrastructure, led by Dragonfly and FirstMark with Coinbase and Ripple in support, suggests enterprise demand is real and specific. Not programmable money. Corporate cash management with better yield and faster settlement.

The market is pricing in regulatory clarity faster than it is pricing in capital rotation. One of those is mispriced.
